afternoon.headline: Tech Strength Lifts Market as VIX Plummets
afternoon.summary: The market saw broad gains led by semiconductors, with INTC and MU among the top performers. The VIX dropped significantly, and the CNN Fear & Greed index moved closer to neutral. Traders are positioning ahead of key CPI data and upcoming earnings.

highlights.label: VIX Collapse
highlights.text: The VIX fell 12.04% to close at 18.92, indicating a decrease in expected market volatility.

highlights.label: Semiconductor Rally
highlights.text: INTC, MU, and MRVL were among the top gainers, reflecting strength in the semiconductor sector.

highlights.label: NVDA Flow
highlights.text: Aggressive call buying was noted in NVDA, with volume significantly exceeding open interest on expiring contracts.

highlights.label: CPI Watch
highlights.text: Markets are anticipating the upcoming CPI data release on June 10th, which could influence future Fed policy.

highlights.label: Model Picks
highlights.text: The model highlighted bullish conviction on SNOW and JPM, and bearish conviction on NKE ahead of CPI.
